palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward. Here's a palindrome with over 255 characters:

```
A man, a plan, a canal: Panama. Never odd or even. Madam In Eden, I'm Adam.
Mister, I'm Eve. Level, civic, radar, deified, deed, deed. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
No 'x' in Nixon. Wow! Step on no pets. Racecar. A Toyota's a Toyota. Go hang a salami I'm a lasagna hog.
Was it a car or a cat I saw? O, the moon is so bright tonight. Never odd or even.
Madam In Eden, I'm Adam. An eye for an eye makes the world go round. Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Go hang a salami I'm a lasagna hog. A Toyota's a Toyota.
```

Please note that generating such long palindromes manually is quite challenging due to their complex structure. In practice, software or specialized algorithms can be used to create long palindromes efficiently.
